title: Analytic: conformal PEC disk cavity, Bessel resonances (E_z and H_z FDTD, conformal boundaries)
description:
A vacuum disk of radius R cut out of a PEC block (pec_domain on box minus disk, pec outer faces, no PML), rung by a gaussian pulse once in E_z (physics 'em') and once in H_z (physics 'em_hz'). The disk centre sits (0.31, 0.17) cells off a cell centre and R = R_cells dx is no multiple of the cell, so each cell sees another sub-cell cut. solver_defaults.conformal_boundaries is on: E_z links to the drawn circle at the bisected wall distance, H_z uses Dey-Mittra cut-cell weights, both at the uncut-grid time step. courant_factor 0.7 (S_courant): the cut-cell stability floor keeps each corrected row within the leap-frog limit, which the vacuum row already fills at the default 0.99 (E_z wall fractions clamp to t >= ~0.5, measured TM01 / TE21 errors 4.2e-3 / 5.6e-3); at 0.7 the floor is t >= ~0.1-0.17 and small H_z areas >= ~0.25 of the cell. The sweep moves R over 19.62-20.89 cells.
Analytic: TM_mn (E_z) f = c j_mn / (2 pi R) with j01 = 2.404826, j11 = 3.831706 (zeros of J0, J1); TE_mn (H_z) with the zeros of J_m': j'11 = 1.841184, j'21 = 3.054237.
Derived values tab: f_TM01, f_TM11 (em.modes) and f_TE11, f_TE21 (em_hz.modes), the resonance finder's frequency within 3 % of each Bessel value, vs their references; expect ~1e-3 or below (estimated, FDTD dispersion at 33-70 cells per wavelength, a few 1e-4, plus the remaining floored walls). The degenerate pairs (TM11, TE11, TE21) split slightly on the grid; the derived value takes the upper one.
Sweep tab: the four frequencies vs R_cells with the dashed Bessel curves, smooth in R. Switch Follow curved walls off (Solvers node) to compare: the staircase disk gives errors of several 1e-3 that jump irregularly with R_cells.
Probes / Resonances: em.modes and em_hz.modes list frequency, wavelength and Q (lossless: Q limited by the record length).
